resolutions.researcher_notes: Searched WebSearch (before quota exhaustion), gem.wiki bibliography leads (research only, never cited), and the row's pre-listed refs_already_on_this_row. Found two independent primary/regulatory-adjacent sources that explicitly name the sub-segments composing this GEM row and describe the pipeline as carrying natural gas: a 2020 Jiangxi Energy Bureau official approval-change notice (jiangxi.gov.cn, recovered via Wayback CDX API after its live origin went dead) and a 2014 Jiangxi Provincial DRC gas-utilization plan PDF hosted on qianzhan.com. Checked petrobest.com, which IS listed in refs_already_on_this_row for this exact row/column, but its text does not contain any of 于都/宁都/广昌/南丰/Yudu/Ningdu/Guangchang/Nanfeng anywhere — it fails standing rule 4(a) (must name the pipeline/segment, not just the parent network) and was excluded from proposed_refs despite being pre-listed. Both sources are independent of each other (different authors/agencies/years) and neither is GEM or a banned aggregator. Tier = high (2 independent sources, one of which is a government regulatory notice).
